select.if: SELECT exercise_log_id AS id, performed_date, 'EXERCISE' AS log_type, name, target_muscle, feedback, NULL AS routine_id, NULL AS total_volume, NULL AS duration_seconds, NULL AS total_sets, NULL AS exercise_details FROM exercise_logs WHERE exercise_log_id = #{logId}

SELECT rl.routine_log_id AS id, rl.performed_date, 'ROUTINE' AS log_type, r.name, rl.target_muscle, NULL AS feedback, rl.routine_id, rl.total_volume, rl.duration_seconds, rl.total_sets, rl.exercise_details FROM routine_logs rl JOIN routines r ON rl.routine_id = r.routines_id WHERE rl.routine_log_id = #{logId}
